reviewer: Kimi actual visual review of the exact 156x210 source and enlarged source-page 18 crop, complete opaque RGB raw and native face crop, unchanged naiwa reference, and full white/cyan/source-alpha/RGB-no-alpha sheet/evidence. The RGB art was rejected for a clearly missing source feature before any alpha operation; no derivative or repair receipt was created.

remaining_reasons: The source has clearly visible grey-dark eyebrows above both eyes, but the complete RGB raw and native face crop have NO eyebrows: the entire yellow forehead/brow area above both green eyes is bare. Restore the source's two distinct grey-dark brow shapes while retaining the cap, gray temple hair, right-facing pose and other features. This is an RGB hair-features-v1 failure; do not mask it with source-alpha repair.
entries.positive_observation: The dark green cap retains its glossy visor, gold piping/cords, separate upper eagle and lower wreath/cockade. Short gray temple hair and narrow gray sideburns remain, with no glasses, moustache or beard and one stern closed mouth. The three-quarter right-facing pose, crop and deep visor shadow remain. The dark olive uniform keeps gold shoulder boards, densely gold-embroidered red collar patches, pale piping and one small black-and-silver throat cross. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar, and the pale cream/grey-beige painted backplate fills the rectangle without an invented replacement backdrop. These correct properties do not offset the clearly absent eyebrows.
entries.visible_limitations: The finest cap-badge and collar embroidery, neck-cross interior and exact sideburn edges are too small to transcribe reliably at 156x210 and are not rejection grounds. Eyebrow absence is instead unmistakable in the native RGB crop, not a judgment based on faint unreadable pixels or alpha numbers.
